basic_info.description: A massive +/- 2800 square foot urban retreat in a superlative Dolores Heights location. With 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, the property offers an excellent solution for someone who needs that kind of space. In a two-unit building for fast-track condo conversion (buyer to verify), the 2-level property has gorgeous wide plank oak floors, high ceilings and an open kitchen-dining-living room floor plan that is the centerpiece of the property. Please see the provided floorplan. There are two bedrooms and two baths on the main level, with three bedrooms and two baths on the lower level, including a light-filled bedroom with home office area that opens to an immense, sunny, exclusive use patio. One of the bedrooms on the lower lever is staged as a yoga room, and a built-in suana (needs heater) make for the opportunity to use the property as a place to relax and recharge. The kitchen and three baths were all recently renovated. Washer/dryers on both levels. See agent about 6-month leased parking option. Centrally locted between Dolores Park, the Valencia commercial corridor and Church St, this is a fantastic value.
